title: hydrolog-network/1
description: River network read by `route network` (ADR-0010): subcatchments, reaches and reservoirs, junctions and one outlet, linked by `from`. A reach has a `method` and the options of `route <method>`. `schema` is required.

id.description: Names the node and its file `<id>.csv`: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-` and not ending with `.`, not a device name of Windows (`con`, `prn`, `aux`, `nul`, `com1` to `com9`, `lpt1` to `lpt9`, any case, any extension); unique without regard to case.

from.description: The ids of the nodes that flow into this one.

times_min.description: Times of the ordinates [min], strictly increasing at a regular step, the same step and first time for every subcatchment; with `discharge_m3s`.

discharge_m3s.description: Discharge at each time [m3/s], not negative; as many values as `times_min`.

value_column.description: Column of `inflows_file` with the discharges [m3/s] of the subcatchment; default the `id`. Not with inline discharges.

from.description: The ids of the nodes that flow into this one.

initial_outflow_m3s.description: Outflow at the first ordinate [m3/s], not negative; default the first inflow ordinate (steady state).

extend_min.description: Time added after the last inflow ordinate, whose value is held [min], not negative; 0 adds nothing. Default: until the outflow has settled (within 0.1 % of the inflow peak), at most ten times the inflow duration.

lag_min.description: Lag [min]: how much later the outflow repeats the inflow; > 0. A lag that is not a whole number of time steps is interpolated (`lag_interpolated`).

from.description: The ids of the nodes that flow into this one.

extend_min.description: Time added after the last inflow ordinate, whose value is held [min], not negative; 0 adds nothing. Default: until the outflow has settled (within 0.1 % of the inflow peak), at most ten times the inflow duration.

k_min.description: Travel time K of the reach [min]; > 0 (about the reach length divided by the flood-wave celerity).

x.description: Weighting factor X, 0 to 0.5: 0 is a linear reservoir (maximum attenuation), 0.5 passes the wave on without attenuation.

subreaches.description: Number of equal sub-reaches of K/N, at least 1; default K/step rounded. Each keeps the weights non-negative for 2KX/step <= N <= 2K(1-X)/step.

extend_min.description: Time added after the last inflow ordinate, whose value is held [min], not negative; 0 adds nothing. Default: until the outflow has settled (within 0.1 % of the inflow peak), at most ten times the inflow duration.

manning_n.description: Manning's roughness [s/m^(1/3)]; > 0. With `bottom_width_m` it describes the section, instead of `celerity_m_per_s` and `top_width_m`.

bottom_width_m.description: Bottom width of the section [m]; >= 0 (0: a triangle). With `manning_n`.

side_slope_m_per_m.description: Bank slope [m/m]: horizontal metres per vertical metre; >= 0 (0: a rectangle); default 0. Part of the section, ignored with `celerity_m_per_s`.

celerity_m_per_s.description: Flood-wave celerity at the reference discharge [m/s]; > 0. With `top_width_m`, instead of the section.

top_width_m.description: Width of the water surface at the reference discharge [m]; > 0. With `celerity_m_per_s`.

reference_discharge_m3s.description: Reference discharge [m3/s] at which the celerity and the width are taken; > 0; default the inflow peak.

extend_min.description: Time added after the last inflow ordinate, whose value is held [min], not negative; 0 adds nothing. Default: until the outflow has settled (within 0.1 % of the inflow peak), at most ten times the inflow duration.

n.description: Number of reservoirs in series; > 0, need not be whole. n = 1 is one reservoir (the most attenuation), a large n is a pure delay of the wave.

k_min.description: Storage constant K of one reservoir [min]; > 0; the reach delays the wave by n K. Instead of `length_km` and `celerity_m_per_s`.

length_km.description: Length of the reach [km]; > 0. With `celerity_m_per_s`, instead of `k_min`: K = L/(n c).
